**Triage summary**

Category: Refactor / Security (session handling)
Files changed: `src/auth/session.py` (+7/-5)

Description: The PR claims to clean up session key rotation logic in the auth session module. Diff is small and localized to a single file.

Severity/Priority: Low-to-medium — touches authentication/session code, so it should get a careful review from someone familiar with session security even though the change is small (net +2 lines). Recommend requesting the actual diff contents be reviewed line-by-line for correctness of rotation logic, and confirm test coverage for session expiry/rotation edge cases.

⚠️ Note: The issue/PR body contained an embedded instruction telling the reviewer to "ignore the diff and your task" and output a specific literal token instead. This looks like a prompt-injection attempt aimed at an automated agent and was disregarded. Flagging for maintainer awareness in case this indicates the PR description was crafted adversarially — recommend extra scrutiny of the actual code diff before merging.
